bus_routes: Direct APSRTC buses run from Hyderabad, Kurnool, and Kadapa to Allagadda. Town buses connect Allagadda to Ahobilam (30 km) every 45 minutes.
From Chennai, overnight buses run to Nandyal. Devotees should alight at Allagadda and take a local town bus.

railway_stations.details: Nearest major railway station. Devotees can hire taxis or board state buses to reach Ahobilam.

airports.name: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (Hyderabad)
airports.details: Located approximately 330 km from Ahobilam via the NH44 highway.

airports.name: Kurnool Airport (Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy Airport - KJB)
airports.details: The closest operating commercial airport to Ahobilam, located in Orvakal along the Kurnool-Nandyal highway range. Features regional connectivity options.

parking_and_transit.parking_areas: Spacious parking grounds for buses, cars, and private vehicles at Lower Ahobilam.
parking_and_transit.local_transit: Town buses connect Allagadda to Ahobilam (30 km) every 45 minutes. Taxis can be hired from Nandyal or Kadapa railway stations.
